quote_a: T ≤ `issuance-not-after`, where T is the time of the **earliest** verified attestation in the presented OTS proof.
quote_b: the verified attestation at the **lowest block height** in the presented OTS proof ... header times are not monotone, so "earliest" means chain order
explanation: ENCODING-V1.md uses "earliest" to mean smallest nTime, while A9 redefines the same word to mean lowest block height; because Bitcoin header times are not monotone, the same OTS proof can select different attestations, producing different T values and therefore different ISSUANCE_WINDOW verdicts.
